title: Certify QF_UFLIA refutations in Lean through the clause log
summary: Adds QF_UFLIA, linear integer arithmetic mixed with uninterpreted sorts and functions, as the sixth fragment certified in Lean through the clause log, reusing the QF_UFLRA encoding over Int with omega and grind as the theory tactics. Also fixes a fragment-independent reconstructor gap for if-then-else terms whose two branches coincide, now proved by a case split.
